description: Upscale an image 2× (source up to 16 MP, 2 credits) or 4× (source up to 4 MP, 4 credits) with Real-ESRGAN. Needs paid credits.

format.description: Output format. png keeps transparency everywhere; webp is smaller; jpg has no transparency.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JPG, PNG or WebP image (up to 25 MB). NukeBG downloads the image itself.

name: upscale_image
title: Upscale image
